Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Nioro du Sahel: The efforts of the FAMa are helping to revive economic activity and transport
Mali.summary: Nioro du Sahel, 17 November 2026 (AMAP) – The efforts of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) to improve security and facilitate the free movement of people and goods are contributing to the gradual return to normality in Nioro du Sahel. . The arrival of several dozen fuel tankers, the resumption of transport links with Bamako and Kayes, and the restocking of markets are all signs of this improvement after nine months of severe disruption.

Mali.title: Air Force: The fleet is gaining in heavy transport and mobility
Mali.summary: CURRENTLY From January to October 2026, the Malian Air Force carried out more than 7,000 sorties, totalling nearly 26,000 flight hours. Brigadier General Alou Boï Diarra, Chief of Staff of this component, also reported that around 28,000 passengers and more than 2,000 tonnes of cargo were transported during this period. .

Mali.title: Mali: The FAMa target bases and...
Mali.summary: Mali: The FAMa target bases and logistics depots of armed groups in Abeïbara and Sévaré The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) have carried out new precision strikes against positions of armed terrorist groups in the Abeïbara and Sévaré sectors . These operations, carried out on 14 and 16 November 2026 as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, targeted assembly points housing armed individuals and military equipment, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces.

Mali.title: Mali : près de 80 000 personnes refoulées de Guinée déjà rapatriées, 13 décès enregistrés
Mali.summary: Le Centre de coordination et de gestion des crises (CECOGEC), organe du gouvernement malien, a annoncé le 16 novembre 2026, que 79 044 personnes refoulées de Guinée sont déjà rentrées chez elles, grâce à 522 véhicules, dont 421 camions et 101 cars. Treize décès ont par ailleurs été enregistrés au cours des opérations. Les sites de regroupement se vident : le principal site du district de Bamako commence à être démantelé, et celui de Kouremalé ne compte plus que quelques personnes.

Mali.title: Air Force: Over 7,000 sorties and 26,000 flight hours completed in ten months
Mali.summary: The Malian Air Force carried out more than 7,000 sorties, totalling nearly 26,000 flight hours between January and October 2026. During this period, it also transported around 28,000 passengers and more than 2,000 tonnes of cargo. These figures were announced on Monday, 16 November 2026, by the Chief of Staff of the Air Force, Brigadier General Alou Boï Diarra, on the occasion of the official handover of new aircraft to the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa).

Mali.title: ORGANISED CRIME IN SIKASSO: A FAKE SOLDIER ARRESTED
Mali.summary: An individual who was impersonating a sergeant in the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) was arrested in Sikasso in recent days for falsely claiming a title. This arrest is reminiscent of a previous case recorded in the same town in October 2024, when a bogus customs officer was arrested for (…) By Mahamane TOURE – NOUVEL HORIZON

Mali.title: Mali: The FAMa carry out precision strikes against terrorist groups in Abeibara and Sévaré
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . On Saturday, 14 November 2026, a gathering point for armed terrorist groups, housing several individuals as well as military equipment, including vehicles and a fuel depot, was the target of precision strikes between eight (8) and ten (10) kilometres north and north-east of Abeïbara.

Mali.title: Mali : 13 morts parmi les personnes refoulées de Guinée
Mali.summary: Les refoulements de ressortissants maliens et burkinabè depuis les zones d’orpaillage de Guinée ont fait 13 morts au Mali, tandis que 79 044 personnes ont été convoyées dans le cadre des opérations de retour, selon un bilan du Centre de coordination et de gestion des crises (CECOGEC), rendu public lundi 16 novembre 2026. Ces données illustrent l’ampleur de cette crise humanitaire qui mobilise depuis plusieurs semaines les autorités maliennes et burkinabè, les services sanitaires et les organisations d’assistance.

Mali.title: Mali: 1,505 fuel tankers in Bamako
Mali.summary: In total, 1,505 tanker trucks carrying petroleum products have arrived in Bamako since the beginning of November, including 840 new vehicles recently received, according to a supply report shared by several media outlets on Monday, 16 November 2020. . This new arrival follows the receipt of 665 tankers on 7 November, under escort by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), in a context marked by persistent disruptions to hydrocarbon supply chains.

Mali.title: Mali-Russia: Seven new aircraft strengthen the military fleet
Mali.summary: On Monday, 16 November 2026, the Malian army took delivery of seven new aircraft acquired as part of its military cooperation with Russia, comprising one strategic transport aircraft and six helicopters, intended to strengthen its mobility, logistical transport and air support capabilities. . The handover ceremony, presided over by the Head of State, Army General Assimi Goïta, took place at Bamako-Sénou's President Modibo Keïta International Airport, in the presence of several government and military officials.

Mali.title: Guinea: A government delegation from Mali visits Conakry
Mali.summary: CONAKRY – A high-level ministerial delegation from the Republic of Mali arrived in Conakry on Tuesday, 10 November 2026. Led by the Minister of Mines, Professor Amadou Keïta, the delegation was welcomed on arrival by the Chief of Staff of Guinea's Ministry of Mines and Geology. This official visit is part of the Malian authorities' participation in the first edition of the Simandou Mining Summit, which is scheduled to open this Wednesday, 11 November, on Kassa Island, Africaguinee.com has learned from sources close to the department headed by Bouna Sylla.

Niger.title: Celebration of the 15th edition of African Road Safety Day: ANISER conducts a major roadside inspection operation in Niamey
Niger.summary: As part of the celebrations for the 15th edition of African Road Safety Day, the Nigerien Road Safety Agency (ANISER) organised a major road safety check operation in the city of Niamey on Sunday, 15 November 2020. . Conducted jointly with the National Police, the National Gendarmerie and the Municipal Police, this operation aims to ensure that road users, namely motorcyclists and motorists, comply with the Highway Code.

Niger.title: NDLEA arrests eight cocaine couriers, recovers 634 wraps
Niger.summary: Operatives of the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency have arrested eight members of a transnational drug trafficking cartel accused of moving cocaine from Lagos through Kano, Niger Republic and Libya to Europe. The suspects, who allegedly swallowed cocaine pellets to evade security checks, excreted a total of 634 wraps weighing 13.795 kilogrammes while in NDLEA custody.

Niger.title: Niger: Appointment of New Secretaries General to the Ministries of Defence and the Interior
Niger.summary: Niamey, 17 November (ANP) – Brigadier General MAMANE SOULEY, General Officer of the Nigerien Armed Forces, has been appointed Secretary General of the Ministry of National Defence, while Colonel Major NOMA DARI has been promoted to Deputy Secretary General, according to a decree issued by the President of the Republic and made public on 16 November 2026. . At the Ministry of the Interior, Public Security and Territorial Administration, Police Commissioner General Ayouba Abdou Rahamane has been appointed Secretary General of the said ministry, according to the same source.

Niger.title: Customs cooperation: Nigerian trainee officers on an immersion programme in Niamey to familiarise themselves with border security strategies
Niger.summary: As part of the cooperation between the customs administrations of Niger and Nigeria, thirteen (13) trainee officers from the Nigerian Customs Service (NCS) will be carrying out a study visit in Niamey from 14 to 21 November 2026, in order to analyse the experience of their counterparts from the Nigerien Directorate General of Customs (DGD) in combating transnational threats.

Niger.title: Niger: Police Commissioner General Aboubacar Issaka Oumarou, new Director General of the National Police
Niger.summary: Niamey, 17 November (ANP) – Police Commissioner General Aboubacar Issaka Oumarou, formerly Director of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS), has been appointed Director General of the National Police (DGPN), by decree signed on 13 November by the President of the Republic, Army General Abdourahamane Tiani. . With several years of experience in the field of public safety, the new Director General of the National Police has a professional career marked by significant responsibilities in Niger and abroad.

Niger.title: Tahoua: Significant quantity of weapons and ammunition seized in Ibecetane
Niger.summary: Tahoua, 17 November (ANP) – A large quantity of weapons and ammunition has been seized by the Niger National Guard (GNN) in Ibecetane, in the Rural Commune of Akoubounou, Abalak Department (Tahoua Region). This seizure was presented to the Governor of the Region, Colonel-Major Souleymane Amadou Moussa, on Monday, 16 November 2026, on the premises of the Tahoua Regional District of the GNN.

Niger.title: Niger: A new Director General at the head of the DGPN
Niger.summary: Niamey, 16 November (ANP) – On Friday, 13 November 2020, the President of the Republic, Army General Abdourahamane Tiani, signed two decrees appointing the new Director General and Deputy Director General of the National Police (DGPN). This concerns Chief Police Commissioner Aboubacar Issaka Oumarou, Service No. 50 865, appointed Head of the General Directorate of the National Police (DGPN), and Divisional Police Commissioner Abdoulaye Maman Mijinyawa, Service No.
